about_the_game:
🐔 About this game

One chicken runs for its life. Wolves on your tail. Wheat in your sights.

Runimals is a chaotic 3D endless runner where you dash, dodge, and gobble whatever’s in front of your beak — all while a hungry pack is hot on your heels.

You’re not the hero. You’re the snack on legs. And the clock is ticking.

In Runimals, you take control of a hungry chicken. Or a sheep. Or a tiger with a serious case of the jitters. Survive as long as you can, collect food (which doubles as your currency), activate crazy power-ups — and unlock new animals, skins, and chaos along the way.

🎮 Features:

  • Run, jump, survive: Avoid obstacles, sprint for your life, and grab your meal — before you become the meal yourself.

  • 3 crazy power-ups:
    🐾 Speed Boost — For those who think a chicken can’t fly.
    🐸 Jump Boost — Two jumps, one goal: don’t die.
    ❄️ Freeze Boost — Freeze your hungry pursuers in their tracks.

  • Unlockable animals:
    Play as different animals, each with their own survival instincts (and wiggly butts).

  • Cosmetics, baby!
    Hunter skins: So even the wolves look stylish when they catch you.
    Food skins: Why stick to wheat when you can chow down on a burger?

  • High score chase:
    Your longest survival time is saved in the main menu. Beat your own record — or your friends’.

  • Cartoon style with punch:
    Stylized, colorful, and packed with exaggerated action — perfect for quick sessions full of chaos, skill, and laughs.

👀 Who’s Runimals for?
For anyone tired of serious games and just wants to scream in panic while running from hungry wolves. Runimals is the perfect mix of chaotic fun, animal action, and that “just one more run” addiction.

Sharpen your paws, claws, or hooves — dinner’s waiting. And it’s you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: One chicken, many wolves. You’re not the hunter — you’re the snack. Runimals is a chaotic 3D endless runner where you dash, dodge, and devour to stay alive. How long can you survive the food chain?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish
